steps.code:
# Create directories for each unique file name (slides, video_recording)
import os
unique_names = set()
for f in files:
    # Extract file name part after "__" and before extension
    base = os.path.basename(f)  # e.g., "2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    parts = base.split("__")
    if len(parts) == 2:
        file_name = parts[1].rsplit(".", 1)[0]  # remove extension
        unique_names.add(file_name)

print("Unique file names:", unique_names)

# Create directories for each unique name
for name in unique_names:
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{name}"
    print(apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=fs_login['access_token'], recursive=True))

steps.code:
# Move each file to its new location: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
import os

for f in files:
    base = os.path.basename(f)  # e.g., "2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    parts = base.split("__")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping {f}: unexpected format")
        continue
    date_part, rest = parts
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if "." in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit(".", 1)
    else:
        file_name, ext = rest, ""
    # Destination path: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
    dest = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{file_name}/{date_part}.{ext}"
    print(f"Moving {f} -> {dest}")
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        source_file_path=f,
        destination_file_path=dest,
        access_token=fs_login['access_token']
    )
    print(result)
